title: Everyday shopping and forests abroad
summaryZh: 从巧克力到化妆品，英国就商品供应链与非法毁林的关系征求意见，同时区分大不列颠和北爱尔兰的制度安排。
levelReason: 编辑估计B1：以日常商品连接环境问题，使用原因、对比、被动语态及政策条件；专门词汇配中文释义。不是官方分级。

source.name: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
source.title: Government to stamp illegal deforestation out of UK supply chains
source.author: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

adaptation: 2026-11-12整理：依据机构英文新闻稿同语言分级改写并添加中文翻译、词义及原创练习。不是原文、官方课程或机构认可的材料。只使用机构叙述，不转载引语、图片、标志或第三方材料。保留拟议措施与已经实行措施的区别。s17末句为根据措施范围作出的编辑解释；保留2023年数据与2026年报道日期的区别。

sentences.text: A chocolate bar or a bottle of cooking oil may seem far removed from a forest overseas.
sentences.zh: 一块巧克力或一瓶食用油，看起来可能与海外的森林相距甚远。

sentences.text: However, ingredients such as soy and palm oil connect everyday shopping with the way land is used.
sentences.zh: 然而，大豆和棕榈油等原料将日常购物与土地使用方式联系起来。

sentences.text: On 11 November 2026, the UK government opened a consultation on proposals to address illegal deforestation linked to supply chains.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月11日，英国政府启动公众征询，讨论应对与供应链相关的非法毁林的提议。

sentences.text: The proposals concern products sold in Great Britain and materials including soy, palm oil, cattle, cocoa, timber, coffee and rubber.
sentences.zh: 提议涉及在大不列颠销售的产品，以及大豆、棕榈油、牛、可可、木材、咖啡和橡胶等商品。

sentences.text: Forested land can be illegally taken or cleared to create space for producing these goods.
sentences.zh: 覆盖着森林的土地可能被非法侵占或清理，为生产这些商品腾出空间。

sentences.text: That risk reaches beyond food, because these materials also appear in toiletries and cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 这种风险不只涉及食品，因为这些原料也用于洗护用品和化妆品。

sentences.text: Healthy forests support a stable climate, food security and the livelihoods of communities.
sentences.zh: 健康的森林有助于气候稳定、粮食安全和社区居民的生计。

sentences.text: According to the announcement, UK consumption of goods associated with deforestation was linked to about 29,000 hectares of forest loss worldwide in 2023.
sentences.zh: 根据公告，2023年英国对与毁林有关商品的消费，与全球约2.9万公顷的森林损失相关。

sentences.text: That figure describes an earlier year, rather than the amount of forest lost when the new proposals were announced.
sentences.zh: 这一数字描述的是较早年份的情况，并非新提议公布时的森林损失量。

sentences.text: Many British businesses have already tried to reduce the risk voluntarily, while major retailers have called for stronger rules.
sentences.zh: 许多英国企业已自愿尝试降低这一风险，而主要零售商呼吁制定更有力的规则。

sentences.text: The consultation asks businesses, environmental organisations and international stakeholders for their views.
sentences.zh: 这次征询向企业、环保组织和国际利益相关方征求意见。

sentences.text: It includes proposals for compulsory checks on supply chains, using existing legal powers, and for stronger timber regulations.
sentences.zh: 其中包括利用现有法律权限对供应链进行强制核查，以及加强木材监管的提议。

sentences.text: The government also wants the Great Britain system to work alongside the arrangements in Northern Ireland, reducing unnecessary administrative work.
sentences.zh: 政府还希望大不列颠的制度与北爱尔兰的安排相互配合，减少不必要的行政工作。

sentences.text: In Northern Ireland, the EU regulation on deforestation-free products is due to start applying in stages from 30 December 2026.
sentences.zh: 在北爱尔兰，欧盟无毁林产品法规预计从2026年12月30日起分阶段适用。

sentences.text: Businesses there are being encouraged to prepare their supply chains before those rules apply.
sentences.zh: 当地企业正被鼓励在这些规则适用前做好供应链方面的准备。

sentences.text: The longer-term ambition is to move towards a deforestation-free standard.
sentences.zh: 更长远的目标是迈向无毁林标准。

sentences.text: For now, the consultation focuses on illegal deforestation, so it should not be read as a promise that every product is already free from forest loss.
sentences.zh: 目前，征询的重点是非法毁林，因此不应把它理解为每件产品都已不涉及森林损失的承诺。

sentences.note: have already tried与have called for并列，while对比已自愿开展的行动和进一步规则诉求。
should not be read as表示不应将某事解读为……，用于限制结论范围。

questions.text: Which information would help you understand where everyday products come from?
questions.zh: 哪些信息能帮助你了解日常商品的来源？

questions.text: What are the advantages and limits of voluntary action by businesses?
questions.zh: 企业自愿行动有哪些优点和局限？

expressions.note: 原创讨论表达；would可表达设想的效果。
